title: Shores of Panama #2308
meta_description: Welcome to Shores of Panama #2308! This 2BDR beachfront condo boasts a private balcony with ocean views and access to a wide variety of resort amenities including a lagoon-style pool, gym, and more!
description_expanded:
Welcome to Shores of Panama #2308! Set high above the sugar-white shoreline of Panama City Beach, this bright 23rd-floor condo offers stunning Gulf views from both the living room and your private balcony.

Natural light fills the open layout, where a cozy living area and fully equipped kitchen with barstool seating make it easy to settle into vacation mode. Coastal décor and thoughtful touches throughout the home create a relaxed, beach-ready atmosphere. When it's time to unwind, the king bedroom provides a calming retreat with its own ensuite bathroom, while the bunk room and queen sleeper sofa comfortably accommodate groups of up to six. In-unit laundry makes clean up a breeze.

As part of Shores of Panama Resort, you'll enjoy access to a sprawling resort-style pool, outdoor and indoor hot tubs, a tiki bar, a poolside snack stand, coffee shop, gym, nail salon, indoor pool, and direct beach access. And with popular spots like Pineapple Willy's, beachfront activities, and local attractions just steps away, you're perfectly placed for a carefree Gulf Coast escape!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A Pack 'n Play travel crib is available.

Parking Details:
- Every guest is required to register their vehicle upon arrival at the condo. The registration fee is $90 plus tax, which includes access to two parking spaces and 8 wristbands. Guest must provide their booking number at the gate for identification.
- 2 parking spaces in the parking garage.
- The parking garage has a maximum height clearance of 6'11.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)

all: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
